criteria.name: card
criteria.expect: a 400 wide card at pos 0 0, white, radius 12, padding 24, column gap 12, with the title Payment method

criteria.name: field
criteria.expect: a 40 high field with a 2 px #b42318 border and radius 8 holding 4242 4242 4242 4242, with the label Card number above

criteria.name: error
criteria.expect: a 13 pt #b42318 text This card was declined. directly under the field

criteria.name: button
criteria.expect: a primary Pay button filling the width at the end

criteria.name: render
criteria.expect: render Empty.Empty: a payment card with one red-bordered field and an error line, no warnings
